result.overallRead: This resume mostly does what a senior engineering-leader resume must: clear progression from individual contributor to platform owner, measurable outcomes on several high-impact projects, and leadership signals (chairing a board, mentoring). It needs one critical fix: at least one bullet that reads like a duty (no outcome). A couple of small clarity/polish items would raise the level to fully senior-ready.

dimensionNotes.note: Contact, Experience, and Education sections are present as expected for this persona.
Most bullets include measurable outcomes, but at least one senior-role bullet states an activity without an outcome and should be quantified.
Extracted text is clean with no scrambled or interleaved lines that indicate parsing problems.
Bullets generally begin with strong verbs; tense is mixed but not harmful. A minor tense-consistency polish would help.
Recent senior roles receive appropriate space and detail; earlier roles are compact but proportional to recency.
The role sequence reads as a deliberate progression from Data Engineer to Principal Engineer with growing scope and cross-team influence.

findings.originalText: Wrote the design doc adopted as the company standard for pipeline observability.
findings.suggestedText: Wrote the design doc adopted as the company standard for pipeline observability, adopted by [N] teams and resulting in [X%] fewer observability gaps or incidents.
findings.reason: At senior level, a bullet that describes creating a standard needs a measurable outcome (adoption, impact) to prove influence and ROI.

findings.originalText: Mentor 4 senior engineers; 2 have since been promoted to staff level.
findings.suggestedText: Mentored 4 senior engineers; 2 have since been promoted to staff level.
findings.reason: Using past tense keeps verb forms consistent across a role described in past accomplishments and improves scannability.

findings.originalText: Reduced reconciliation breaks 43% by adding row-level lineage tracking.
findings.suggestedText: Reduced reconciliation breaks 43% by adding row-level lineage tracking.
findings.reason: This bullet is strong; consider adding the business impact (time or cost saved) if available to reinforce the achievement.

narrativeAssessment.progression: Clear. The candidate advances logically from Data Engineer to Senior to Staff to Principal at the same company, showing increasing ownership.
narrativeAssessment.scopeGrowth: Visible. Scope expands from building ETL and specific pipelines to owning the platform for multiple product teams and chairing an architecture review board.
narrativeAssessment.spaceAllocation: Appropriate. The most recent and highest-impact role has the most bullets and metrics; older roles are concise but include outcomes.
narrativeAssessment.influenceBeyondDelivery: Evident. Mentoring, chairing the architecture review board, and authoring a company standard demonstrate influence beyond individual execution.
narrativeAssessment.overall: Strong narrative with one notable hole: at least one senior-level bullet reads as activity-only and needs a concrete outcome or adoption metric to support the leadership claim.
